sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase song pages get a button, "Song": the credits (each release, who played what), the performances counted by tour (only the tours it was played on, with its share of the shows), every performance, multiple performances on one date, snippets, the official live downloads and its takes On The Tracks (title, take, running time, the bootlegs and releases it is on), as tables you can filter and sort. Above them: where the song comes from, Released on Album, the lyrics and notes (folded), a Song card (how often and when last played live, released on, live downloads, takes), its tags, media and links; the wiki's page folded below. An On The Tracks page gets "Versions": its takes as one table. Nothing is fetched. The setting is now called "Detail pages: events and songs as tables".

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase event pages (a gig, a show that did not happen, a recording session, a rehearsal, an interview) get a button, "Event", that lays the page out like a MusicBrainz release, from the page itself with nothing fetched. Above the tables: what it was, where and when; About this show; an Event card (type, date and weekday, scheduled time, venue, tour, the year page, running time), the page's tags by family and its YouTube links; the pictures with a chip per kind and per photographer. The tables: the Setlist as one table (Set, #, Song in MusicBrainz style, Segue, Premiere ★ for a song in bold on the wiki, Note), who was on stage with their band and role, the other shows at the venue (this one in bold), the recordings (official releases, bootlegs with their labels, the live download) and the Storyteller's words by song. The wiki's own page stays below, folded, its headings folding too. Setting "Event pages: a detail view of the gig" (on). Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/3rAGVKsBHEv9jGspkJ5X7Z

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Brucebase previews: the scheduled time is read on pages that write it "Scheduled: 21:00 | Local Start Time …" too; the card left it out.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Brucebase previews: a picture now says what its file name tells, the photographer included ("Photo · Cliff Breining · #01", "Setlist · #01a · Handwritten", "Pass · #01 · Backstage"), in the window and in the full-size viewer. The window shows the photos once per photographer, those without a known photographer last. Each group folds on a click on its heading, and a Ctrl+click folds or opens every group at once, so a gig with hundreds of photos can be folded away; the text sections stay as they are.

Brucebase previews: the window ends with the page's tags, folded at first, sorted into Date, Place, Tour, On the page, Songs, People, Releases and more; each tag links to the wiki's list of pages with it. Previews already cached are read once more.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Brucebase: the side bar's show/hide handle now sits at the top of the side bar, as the MusicBrainz sidebar's does, instead of halfway down the window. Scrolled down, it stays near the top of the window; with the side bar hidden, it sits at the top of the page content.
